page0.text: "I don't really know you because we just met, but I don't hate you, Illya. At least, I'd like to get along with you, the way you are now."

page1.text:
"...Really?"
"Er, I've never had a little sister before, it'll be fun. And I won't mention what happened the other night... That's all I can promise you. Can you trust me?"

page2.text:
"Yeah!
If you say so, I'll trust you, Shirou!"
Illya nearly tackles me when she hugs my arm again.

page3.text:
"...Good grief. What's your deal?"
So I grumble, but this isn't so bad, I reassure myself.
